Root.modal.semantic: true = scroll lock + outside pointer interactions blocked; 'trap-focus' = focus trapped only; focus trapping with modal=true requires <Popover.Close> inside <Popover.Popup>; on touch, modal=true blocks outside taps but keeps the page scrollable unless the popup spans nearly the full viewport width

Root.actionsRef.type: RefObject<{ unmount: () => void; close: () => void } | null>
Root.actionsRef.semantic: unmount() is for externally controlled closing animations

Trigger.openOnHover.semantic: also open on hover (popover doubles as an infotip)

Trigger.nativeButton.semantic: set false when render targets a non-button

Trigger.id.semantic: forwarded to the element AND used as the active trigger id in controlled mode

Trigger.payload.semantic: passed to Root children render function

Positioner.sideOffset / alignOffset.semantic: OffsetFunction gets { side, align, anchor, positioner }

Positioner.anchor / collisionAvoidance /.semantic: shared anchoring API across all Base UI popups

Popup.initialFocus.type: boolean | RefObject<HTMLElement|null> | ((openType: InteractionType) => boolean | void | HTMLElement | null)
Popup.initialFocus.semantic: default: first tabbable element inside the popup, except touch-opened popovers which focus the popup itself to avoid the virtual keyboard; InteractionType = 'mouse'|'touch'|'pen'|'keyboard'|''

Popup.finalFocus.type: boolean | RefObject<HTMLElement|null> | ((closeType: InteractionType) => boolean | void | HTMLElement | null)
Popup.finalFocus.semantic: default: trigger or previously focused element

Close.nativeButton.semantic: required inside Popup when modal for touch screen-reader escape

Viewport.children.semantic: only for animated content switches between multiple triggers

dataAttributes: Positioner: data-open, data-closed, data-anchor-hidden, data-side, data-align
Popup: data-open, data-closed, data-starting-style, data-ending-style, data-side, data-align, data-instant ('click'|'dismiss'|'focus'|'trigger-change')
Arrow: data-open, data-closed, data-side, data-align, data-uncentered  (NOTE: Popover Arrow has NO data-instant, unlike Tooltip Arrow)
Viewport: data-current, data-previous, data-activation-direction, data-transitioning, data-instant ('click'|'dismiss'|'focus'|'trigger-change')
renderProp: Identical mechanism to Tooltip: per-part `render` (ReactElement | (props, state) => ReactElement), internally useRender; merge user props with mergeProps; `state` drives automatic data-* attributes.
controlled: Uncontrolled `defaultOpen`/`defaultTriggerId`; controlled `open`/`triggerId` + `onOpenChange(open, eventDetails)`; `actionsRef` { unmount, close }; detached triggers via Popover.createHandle() with handle/open(triggerId)/close()/isOpen; `onOpenChangeComplete(open)` after animations.
formIntegration: None (verified: no hidden inputs or form context anywhere under popover/*.mjs). Trigger and Close render native <button>; set type explicitly when rendered inside a form.
keyboard: Escape closes (reason 'escape-key'); focus-out closes (reason 'focus-out') when not modal or when focus truly leaves; Tab is not trapped unless modal (true or 'trap-focus'). No arrow-key navigation inside the popup content. Outside press closes (reason 'outside-press').
notableDifferences: `modal` exists and accepts 'trap-focus' — React Aria popovers cannot trap focus; and with modal=true focus trapping is only enabled if <Popover.Close> is rendered inside the popup.
Dismissal is not disabled by a boolean prop; use onOpenChange eventDetails.cancel() (no isDismissable/isKeyboardDismissDisabled equivalent).
Trigger supports openOnHover + delay/closeDelay — hover-open is a first-class popover mode, whereas React Aria treats hoverable popovers separately.
Composition is Portal > Backdrop?/Positioner > Popup (+ optional Arrow/Title/Description/Close/Viewport) instead of a single Floating element with placement props.
Animation states are data-starting-style / data-ending-style (+ data-instant) instead of React Aria's data-entering/data-exiting.
data-instant value set differs from Tooltip ('click'|'dismiss'|'focus'|'trigger-change').
Backdrop has no forceRender prop (Dialog/AlertDialog Drawer Backdrops do).
